title: karandeepsingh-blog
description: Search and read Karandeep Singh's DevOps and AWS blog: articles and cheatsheets.
summary: Search and read Karandeep Singh's DevOps and AWS blog: articles and cheatsheets.
offersHint: Search and read Karandeep Singh's DevOps and AWS blog: articles and cheatsheets. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://karandeepsingh.ca/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_posts
toolsPreview.description: Search Karandeep Singh's blog (DevOps/AWS articles and cheatsheets). Returns ranked cards with title, URL, tags, date, reading time, and summary.

toolsPreview.name: read_post
toolsPreview.description: Read a post's full text by URL, paginated. Returns a window of characters; call again with the returned next offset to continue.

toolsPreview.name: list_recent
toolsPreview.description: List the most recently published posts.

toolsPreview.name: browse_by_tag
toolsPreview.description: List posts with a given tag (e.g. aws, lambda, cost, aurora). Use list_topics to see all tags.

toolsPreview.name: list_topics
toolsPreview.description: List every tag on the blog with a post count, for discovering what's covered.

toolsPreview.name: related_posts
toolsPreview.description: Given a post URL, find other posts that share the most tags with it.

toolsPreview.name: random_post
toolsPreview.description: Return a random post from the blog — a surprise pick.

toolsPreview.name: get_cheatsheet
toolsPreview.description: Jump straight to a cheatsheet by topic (docker, cloudformation, cost, aurora, kubernetes, …) and get its full text.

toolsPreview.name: list_cheatsheets
toolsPreview.description: List all cheatsheets (quick-reference guides) on the blog.

toolsPreview.name: quiz_me
toolsPreview.description: Test the user's knowledge with real multiple-choice questions written for the blog's articles. Returns questions, options, and an answers section with explanations. Ask the questions first, then reveal the answers.

toolsPreview.name: get_commands
toolsPreview.description: Return just the runnable commands and code blocks from the best-matching article or cheatsheet — no prose. Use when the user wants the command, not the explanation.
